what_happened: The last attempt on job 20261028-055601-hg0n (line 20261028-034820-v3rf) passed planning, built the change, and passed fmt, clippy and 1545 tests. It then stopped on low disk (9.8 of 10.0 GB free) before the verifier ran. The scope guard counted that environment stop as spend on the line and paused it. The operator lifted the pause by hand after disk was back to 28 GB free. The next attempt resumes the kept candidate and needs only one verifier call, about $0.50. The event lists no unmet criteria, findings or failed checks.
cause: The scope guard treats all spend on a line as one number. It does not record why an attempt stopped, and it does not know how much work is left. A stop caused by the environment (low disk) looks the same as a stop caused by the work being too big or the producer failing. A kept candidate that has passed every check and needs only the verifier is therefore treated like a runaway line. The only way past it is for an operator to judge the remaining cost and override the guard.
prevention: Record a stop reason on every attempt. Have the scope guard exclude attempts that ended on an environment stop (low disk, container reclaim) from the spend and attempt counts, or count them separately. When an attempt has a kept candidate that passed the build and test checks, have the guard estimate the remaining cost as the verifier only. It should resume that candidate automatically if the estimate fits the limit. It should pause for the operator only when the spend came from the work itself.
proposed_request:
Change the scope guard so it does not pause a line for an environment stop. Outcome: when an attempt ends because of an environment condition (low free disk, container reclaim) and not because of the work, its spend is not counted toward the line's scope-guard limit. The line keeps its kept candidate. After the environment is healthy again, the next attempt resumes that candidate without an operator lifting any pause. Each attempt's stop reason is recorded so the guard can tell the two cases apart. Acceptance:
- A test replays a line whose last attempt passed fmt, clippy and tests and stopped on low disk. The line is not paused, and the next attempt runs only the verifier.
- A test shows a line whose attempts failed on the work itself is still paused at the existing limit.
- The stop reason appears in the attempt's record, and the record passes the records validation.
